title: Stress fracture of the second metatarsal and sprain of lisfranc joint in a pre-professional ballet dancer.
journal: Journal of dance medicine & science : official publication of the International Association for Dance Medicine & Science

sections.label: UNLABELED
sections.text: We present the case of a 14-year-old pre-professional ballerina that demonstrates common features of two conditions affecting the midfoot that are often missed or subject to delay in diagnosis in such young athletes: 1. stress fractures at the base of the second metatarsal, and 2. sprain of the Lisfranc joint complex. While these represent potentially career-altering injuries in the professional dancer, this case demonstrates that a high index of clinical suspicion, careful physical exam, appropriate radiographic assessment, and prompt treatment are essential to achieving the best possible outcome.
